clips.caption:
A guru once called Kevin Trudeau asking for help selling his own manifesting book.

Kevin Trudeau's answer: if you really know how to manifest, why call me? Just manifest a New York Times bestseller.

He had done it six times already - plus 100 million books sold and companies worth over $25 billion in sales.

Mansions, Rolls Royces, dinners with kings and presidents. All of it, he says, came from the same process.

If you cannot manifest results for yourself, can you really teach someone else how?

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #lawofattraction #moneymindset #wealthmindset #successmindset

clips.end_words: have to duplicate that type of success
clips.caption:
Most people copy the wrong version of a rich person.

Kevin Trudeau says you cannot duplicate how someone thinks or acts today - you duplicate how they acted when they were broke, just starting out.

A plane needs full throttle down a long runway before it ever reaches cruise. Once airborne, the pilot eases off.

Watching a rich person now is watching them on cruise control. In 1975, Kevin Trudeau worked 14-16 hour days, seven days a week - something he does not do today.

Are you copying someone's cruise control, or their runway?

#kevintrudeau #entrepreneurship #successmindset #moneymindset #wealthmindset #hustle

clips.end_words: depth of knowledge in the data
clips.caption:
Ed Forman was one of Kevin Trudeau's closest friends and one of the greatest motivational speakers he ever knew. But he waited.

He did not start teaching success principles until after he had made a couple hundred million dollars - in construction, oil and gas, real businesses.

Compare that to someone who read every personal-development book and started selling advice without ever having applied it themselves.

Kevin Trudeau's point: there is a difference between knowing about something and knowing it from the inside, because you lived it.

Whose advice are you actually following - someone who did it, or someone who just explains it well?

#kevintrudeau #successmindset #entrepreneur #wealthmindset #businessowner #moneymindset

Kevin Trudeau says most people get the definition of "rich" wrong.

Decades ago, a millionaire actually had $100 million in today's dollars - sitting in cash, not on paper.

That is the split he draws: people with $100 million in cash versus people earning $100-200 thousand a year who call themselves worth $100 million because of real estate.

But if you cannot sell it, it is not cash. It is just a number you are hoping someone will pay you for one day.

Which one are you actually building - real wealth, or real estate you cannot touch?

#kevintrudeau #wealthmindset #moneymindset #realestate #richmindset #financialfreedom

clips.end_words: theta is the key to wealth
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau calls theta his "wealth wave" - the brainwave frequency he says moves fastest through the physical universe.

Broadcast a desire while your brain sits mostly in theta, he claims, and it reaches further than a desire sent out on any other frequency. That is why he calls it the key to attracting wealth.

Most people spend their waking hours in a completely different, weaker frequency - which is exactly why he says their goals never seem to land.

Whether or not you buy the science, the habit underneath it is real: calm, focused minds get further than anxious, scattered ones.

Which frequency have you been broadcasting on all week?

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #lawofattraction #brainwaves #wealthmindset #mindsetshift
